name: iota-constant-deletion-renumbers
description: Deleting a constant of an iota block renumbers the constants after it, so a constant whose deletion moves a constant that code names is retained by the enum-group class, whatever its type: untyped, of a predeclared or local type, or of a type the target does not declare. Such a constant has no enumerated type whose values the class follows, so nothing proves the move harmless. A constant whose deletion moves no named constant is reported.
